en-US.name: Steady Noise
en-US.summary: White, pink, and brown noise for sleep, focus, or masking sound.
en-US.description:
Steady Noise plays continuous white, pink, or brown noise.

White noise is bright and even across all frequencies. Pink noise is softer, like steady rain. Brown noise is deeper still, like a distant waterfall or the rumble of a plane cabin.

How to use it:
- Say "Alexa, open Steady Noise", then name a color: "brown noise"
- Add a time if you like: "pink noise for 30 minutes"
- "Alexa, pause" and "Alexa, resume" work anytime

White noise is free for up to an hour at a time. Steady Noise Premium (monthly subscription with a free trial) adds pink and brown noise and lets any color play all night or for a time you choose.

Each sound is a one-hour seamless loop generated from scratch, level-matched so switching colors does not jump in volume.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say 'open Steady Noise', then 'white noise' (free, plays up to one hour). In the same session, 'brown noise' or 'pink noise' triggers the Premium upsell; accept it to subscribe in the sandbox. 'pink noise for 1 minute' (with Premium) demonstrates the timer: the stream ends after one minute. Pause, resume, stop, and the device play/pause buttons are handled. No account linking or permissions are required.
